decision_recommendation: Backend-owned bounded monitor/snapshot/watch/disconnect; no arbitrary async observer callback or backend-to-service dependency. Real runner extraction into root-chosen rustusb-service; foreground adapters preserve original wire/event/signal/backpressure contracts.
cross_review: Aligned with journal_integration_review on backend authority, ImportStarted vs flush accepted vs actual cleanup, no false client enumeration, and claim cancellation ownership.
executed: Read-only code/hash parsing only; no Cargo/CLI/QEMU/USB.
